sentimento.text1: 📈 THE WINNER CONTRACT SPREAD WIDENED FOR THE SECOND DAY, and this time with only one side moving: Flávio Bolsonaro rose to 50.75% (vol USD 10.64M) and Lula stayed flat at 47.50% (vol USD 11.00M), against 49.65% and 47.50% in the confirmed reading of Sep 13. The distance went from 2.15pp to 3.25pp. ⚖️ Both prices remain inside their own series ranges: 4.35pp below Flávio’s high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and 20.00pp below Lula’s high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. Presidential book at USD 149.68M.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ TWO NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON SEP 14, AND THEY DISAGREE ON THE SIGN OF THE RUNOFF. BTG/Nexus (fieldwork from Sep 11 to 13, 2,003 telephone interviews) puts Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro by 47% to 46% in the pair, and Genial/Quaest (fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, 2,004 face-to-face interviews) puts Flávio ahead by 42% to 40%. Both differences fit inside each house’s 2.0 margin. ⭐ In the first round they AGREE on the distance: 42% to 37% in BTG/Nexus and 36% to 31% in Genial/Quaest, the same 5 points, which do not fit inside two margins. On Aug 21 two national polls of the same day also flipped the pair between them.
sentimento.text3: 📅 THE WEEK’S CALENDAR REMAINS HEAVY: the Superior Electoral Court registry lists ten national polls scheduled for release between Sep 15 and 18, with MDA and Indexa on Sep 15, Datatrends and American Analytics on Sep 16, FIVE on the same Sep 17 (AtlasIntel, Datafolha, PoderData, Gerp and 100 Cidades) and the 40,500-interview Veritá on Sep 18. 📌 A registration is not a result: the date is the institute’s commitment, and the figure only exists when it publishes.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 50.75% in the winner contract, a rise of 1.10pp that interrupts two days of decline, 4.35pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and 78.00% in the first-round runner-up contract, up 1.00pp. He has 37% in the first round of the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 and 31% in the Genial/Quaest poll, two points above each house’s previous round, and in the runoff pair against Lula he is ahead in Genial/Quaest, 42% to 40%, and behind in BTG/Nexus, 46% to 47%. Ronaldo Caiado is at 0.15% in the winner contract, rose 7.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 16.00%, and has 5% and 4% in the first round of the two houses.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 47.50% in the winner contract, flat against the confirmed reading of Sep 13, and 20.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the first-round runner-up contract he fell 2.50pp, to 19.50%. He has 42% in the first round of the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14 and 36% in the Genial/Quaest poll, 5 points ahead in both, and in the runoff pair he wins in BTG/Nexus by 47% to 46% and loses in Genial/Quaest by 40% to 42%, both inside the margin. Government approval stands at 43% against 50% disapproval in Genial/Quaest and at 47% against 49% in BTG/Nexus. Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, with USD 7.53M accumulated.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury remains the favourite in the first-round third-place contract, but fell 8.55pp there, to 47.05%, the largest move of any contract on the dashboard in this round, and he has 6% and 7% in the first round of the two national polls of Sep 14, below each house’s previous round. Renan Santos rose 3.00pp in that same contract, to 37.50%, and the spread between the two narrowed from 21.10pp to 9.55pp. Renan’s winner contract still holds USD 13.43M accumulated, the second-largest individual volume in the book, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas’s, at USD 14.07M. Romeu Zema has 1% in the first round of both houses and loses the runoff pair to Lula outside the margin in both.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Sep 14, 13:02 BRT (16:02 UTC). ⭐ In this round all FIVE monitored contracts received a new price: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate majority, the latter with the Liberal Party at 83.50%. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and the confirmation is done contract by contract.

inss.text1: 🔴 THE ACT OF Sep 12 HALTS THE INSS CASES, AND DOES NOT CHANGE THEIR RAPPORTEUR: on Saturday night, Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into suspicions involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered the Banco Master and INSS fraud inquiries to be held SUSPENDED at the Court's Presidency, and did so WITHOUT removing André Mendonça as their rapporteur, in a decision the two justices agreed between themselves before it was signed (Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo, outlets from groups independent of each other, both on Sep 12). ⚠️ THE HEADLINES OF FOLHA, CARTACAPITAL AND METRÓPOLES SAY HE REMOVED MENDONÇA, AND THE BODIES SAY THE OPPOSITE. Poder360 writes, in so many words, that the decision was taken without removing justice André Mendonça as rapporteur, and adds that it was by common agreement and that the two spoke beforehand. The page goes with the body.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: the two sets come to be held in the same place, the Court’s Presidency, and keep the same rapporteur. The page does not merge the objects of investigation, which remain distinct, and records only that both were halted on Sep 12.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval is now the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13: 43% approve, 50% disapprove and 7% do not know, the same approval and disapproval figures as the house’s round of Sep 07. The dashboard keeps one house per block on purpose, so the internal series does not mix. 📊 And the BTG/Nexus poll of Sep 14, from another house, measures 47% approval against 49% disapproval, compared with 45% and 50% in its round of Sep 08.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is about approval and not about acts: there is no new act in the INSS fraud inquiry on Sep 14 in the collected news, and the structured government rating moves to the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, with approval and disapproval unchanged against the house’s previous round. The move of the day is in the market, where the winner contract spread widened 1.10pp.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON THE EVE OF THE SEP 15 SESSION THE PROCEEDINGS MOVED ON TWO FRONTS. On Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered to the offices of Cristiano Zanin and Gilmar Mendes the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, which the two had requested directly from the police, after André Mendonça had come out against full sharing (Gazeta do Povo, and Estadão and G1 report the same delivery). And Edson Fachin asked Mendonça, the rapporteur, to lift the secrecy of data on Banco Master’s payment network, after a request by Alexandre de Moraes made on Sep 13 and a favourable opinion from the Prosecutor General’s Office (Poder360 and Folha de S.Paulo). ⚠️ There are headlines saying that this secrecy HAS ALREADY BEEN LIFTED, and the texts read do not support that, so the page records the request and not the lifting.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Moraes and Vorcaro and suspended the Master and INSS inquiries at the Court’s Presidency, without removing Mendonça as rapporteur; on Sep 13 the Federal Police answered the 24-hour deadline on the phone, saying it had the technical conditions to send a copy to the justices, Mendonça asked Fachin to look into possible pressure on police investigators and warned that opening the full phone contents would disrupt the trial, and Moraes asked for the secrecy of payment data to be lifted; on Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered the data to Zanin and Gilmar and Fachin made the request to Mendonça.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the confirmed reading of 13:02 BRT on Sep 14. In that reading, the winner contract of the investigated candidate rose 1.10pp, after having fallen 4.00pp on Sep 12 and 0.30pp on Sep 13, and the spread to the runner-up WIDENED 1.10pp. AFOS records the order of the facts and does not attribute a cause to the price, because the book is arbitraged continuously and no single reading separates one motive from another.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 13 to 14 is who has access to the material and what remains under secrecy, not the content of the case. Two justices now have the full contents of Vorcaro’s phone, the Court’s president asked the rapporteur to open data on payments, and the session that examines the request to investigate Moraes remains scheduled for Sep 15.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on Sep 14. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, together with Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: On Sep 13 he asked for the secrecy of data on Banco Master’s payment network to be lifted, a request the Prosecutor General’s Office supported and that Edson Fachin forwarded to André Mendonça on Sep 14. The session that examines the request to investigate him remains scheduled for Sep 15.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 14 his office received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, as did Cristiano Zanin’s, after the two had requested the material directly from the police, on the eve of the Sep 15 session.
stf.dino: On Sep 14 he authorized the Federal Police’s Operation Transparência 3, with four search and seizure warrants in the Federal District and in São Paulo and congressman Cezinha de Madureira as the main target, on suspicion of influence peddling, exploitation of prestige, passive corruption and money laundering, with no arrest. On Sep 12 he had ordered the lifting of secrecy in the investigation into the financing of the film Dark Horse, made public on Sep 13.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 13 he asked Edson Fachin to request clarification from the Federal Police about possible pressure on the case’s investigators, and warned that opening the full contents of Daniel Vorcaro’s phone would disrupt the Sep 15 trial. On Sep 14 he received from Fachin the request to lift the secrecy of data on Banco Master’s payment network, and he remains rapporteur of the Master and INSS cases.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. On the eve of the session that examines the request to investigate a justice of the Court, two justices received the full contents of Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, the Court’s president asked the rapporteur to open data on payments, and the Federal Police carried out an operation on suspected sale of influence before the higher courts. The Sep 15 session falls less than three weeks before the first round.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 EASED 0.60pp and stands at 4.00% (vol USD 91 thousand), confirmed reading of Sep 14, 13:02 BRT, against 4.60% in the confirmed reading of Sep 13. ⚠️ It is NOT an extreme: it remains 22.10pp below the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 1.90pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8. ⚠️ The accumulated volume, of USD 91 thousand, is small enough for isolated orders to move the price, and that caveat holds in both directions. 📌 The move happens on the eve of the Sep 15 session, on the day two justices received the full contents of Daniel Vorcaro’s phone and the Court’s president asked the rapporteur to open data on Banco Master payments. The order of the facts is measured, the link between them is not.
stf.fachin: On Sep 14 he asked André Mendonça to lift the secrecy of data on Banco Master’s payment network, after a request by Alexandre de Moraes and a favourable opinion from the Prosecutor General’s Office (Poder360 and Folha de S.Paulo). On the night of Sep 12 he had taken over as rapporteur of the investigation into Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and suspended the Master and INSS inquiries at the Presidency, without removing Mendonça as rapporteur, in agreement with him.
